name: Interior Glamour Mirror Photography
name_es: Fotografía de glamour interior frente al espejo

pose_and_framing_block.framing: vertical composition. Mirror on the left showing the face and front of the torso; actual subject on the right, closer to the camera. Subject and reflection slightly overlap in the composition
pose_and_framing_block.reflection: two views of the same person: actual body seen from behind and frontal mirror reflection, with physically consistent anatomy and perspective

environment_block.background: cool blue-gray walls, large metal-framed wall mirror, side cabinet with a small decorative figurine or box
environment_block.elements: cylindrical white wall sconce on the right, softly blurred foreground furniture

lighting_block.lighting: warm interior illumination mainly from the wall sconce on the right, creating a golden edge along the shoulder, hair and side of the body. Softer illumination on the left, warm skin tones contrasting with the cooler blue-gray room

camera_and_style_block.camera: sharp focus on the subject and mirror reflection, slightly softer background, vertical framing
camera_and_style_block.style: editorial glamour photography, realistic visible skin texture with a soft sheen, restrained contrast, clean photographic finish

constraints_block.preserve: subject identity, facial features and body proportions
